problem:
The quadratic Taylor approximation of the function $f(x)$ about $x=a\in {R}^{3}$ is given by

$$
f(x)≈-3+\frac{1}{2}(x-a)^{T}[\begin{aligned}2 & 1 & 1 \\ 1 & -2 & 0 \\ 1 & 0 & -2\end{aligned}](x-a).
$$

Given that the eigenvalues of ${f}^{″}(a)$ are ${\lambda }_{1}=-2,{\lambda }_{2}=-\sqrt{6}$ and ${\lambda }_{3}=\sqrt{6},$ what type of point is $a?$

activity_context.topic_title: Global vs. Local Extrema and Critical Points of Multivariable Functions
